scene: The bell toll summons three transit shuttles to the lighthouse platform.
picture: Side-scrolling view of the lighthouse transit deck. Far left sits a sleek pink bullet train with open doors. Left stands the top-knotted player with his ukulele. Centre rests an undulating green dragon maglev train. Far right, a glass cloud cable pod floats beside the railing.
shown: a sleek pink bullet train docked at the rail platform on the far left
a glowing green maglev dragon train waiting patiently in the centre
a floating round glass cloud pod hovering by the dock on the far right
